question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Accusation
solution:
The correct answer is: **Approval**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Accusation"** means a charge or claim that someone has done something illegal or wrong. (आरोप)

 
 
• **Example:** He faced an accusation of theft from his employer.
 
 
 
• **"Approval"** refers to the act of accepting or agreeing to something, often after careful consideration. (अनुमोदन)
 
 
• **Example:** The new project received approval from the board of directors.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Accusation'** is **'Approval'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Approval**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Blast** (विस्फोट): A destructive wave of air pressure resulting from an explosion.

 
 
• **Example:** The blast from the bomb shattered all the windows in the building.
 
 
 
• **Indictment** (अभियोग): A formal charge or accusation of a serious crime.
 
 
• **Example:** The grand jury handed down an indictment against the suspect.
 
 
 
• **Remuneration **: (पारिश्रमिक): Payment or compensation received for services or employment.
 
 
• **Example:** Employees receive remuneration for their work at the end of each month.
